deployment_observations.reason_not_paired: Concurrent deployments repeatedly held the global build lock and restarted or garbage-collected the shared builder cache.

result.reason: The Stagefile-generated graph was faster for three isolated cached source rebuilds, but no contention-free paired end-to-end deployment matrix completed.

remaining_uncertainty: The source-rebuild comparison used separate builder cache volumes to prevent one large graph from evicting the other.
The measured source-phase advantage is about 0.31 seconds and may be negligible in a deployment dominated by builder restart, cache restoration, or image export.
Historical deployment observations used different cache states and are not a performance control.
Exact compressed image bytes and per-trial observer overhead were not emitted.
A final end-to-end claim requires at least three paired deployments during an exclusive builder window.
